protocol.method: Deterministic enumeration using the actual legacy itemCompatibility and normalizeInventory from git show, followed by current migration and idempotent v2 validation.
protocol.generatedState: newGame for each class; XP replaced by the enumerated value; credits 10000; Spectre true; all seven companions recruited; Normandy location; one compatible old catalog item assigned to its actor slot with a matching owned exemplar.
perCaseAssertions: All 48 legacy shop stock counts unchanged
protocol.randomization: None; this is an inventory-state audit, without combat simulation or wall-clock timing.

limitations: Generated legacy fixtures are validated inventory states, not real historical player save files or complete replayed campaigns.
The 8268 cases vary one assigned catalog item at a time; they do not enumerate every combination of nine slots, owned counts, stocks, or progression states.
The armor exception is checked by catalog reference, matching the engine count-based item model; individual physical exemplars are not represented.
This report does not validate canonical ME1 ranks, numeric statistics, artwork, browser behavior, combat frame behavior, or full electronics talents.
No application source or test files were modified by this audit; only this report and its /tmp executable were written.
